data.title: Make a Shape
data.description: Make your own shapes that have the properties asked for.

challenges.instruction: Make a shape with 4 sides, exactly 2 right angles and exactly 1 pair of parallel sides.
challenges.hint: Count your sides, then check each corner and each pair of sides.
challenges.narration: Let's make a shape of your own!
